artifacts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Design a refined NEW mobile interface presentation for "富士見新聞文庫". Reference image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the restrained black-and-white Japanese editorial direction, NOT an edit target. The user now specifically requests: move/redesign the bookmark collection entry, redesign the audio player, and review settings. This board covers BOOKMARKS and both PLAYER states. A later separate board covers settings. Make actual layout improvements, not just colors.

BOARD: High-resolution landscape, THREE complete, large, equal 390:844 mobile screenshots side by side, frontal and flat, all at same scale. Subtle neutral warm-gray #E8E7E4 background, generous outer margins, white screen surfaces, 18px rounded outer artboard corners, very slight shadow, NO phone hardware or perspective. Small title "富士見新聞文庫" and subtitle "收藏入口与朗读播放器". Captions below screens exactly "收藏", "阅读 · 收起播放器", "朗读 · 展开播放器". Maximize screen size and readable CJK text.

STYLE: retain white #FFFFFF, neutral almost-white #FAFAF8, black ink #20201E, secondary warm gray #777670, dividers #E4E3DF. Tiny restrained Japanese vermilion #A43A32 ONLY for a short active navigation marker or a tiny bookmark state; less than 1% UI area. No blue/purple/green interface, no gradients, no beige wash. Mincho serif for main headings and Japanese prose; contemporary Japanese sans for UI and playback labels. 24px phone margins. Editorial calm with appropriate content density. No excessive cards, no giant English labels, no random numbered sections. Beautiful muted photographic thumbnails.

CRITICAL NAVIGATION CHANGE:
On screens 1 and 2, bottom navigation has EXACTLY FIVE icon+text items in THIS order: "日刊", "閲読室", "收藏", "書架", "辞書". The bookmark collection is now the CENTER bottom tab with a regular outline bookmark icon, same size as other icons, no giant floating central action button. "設置" is REMOVED from bottom navigation and reached from the small GEAR in the top app bar on normal list pages.
On screen 1 收藏 selected, on screen 2 閲読室 selected. Selected item black with fine red line above; no filled selected background. 48px touch areas. Sufficient bottom safe area.
Do NOT use the bookmark icon in the app header as collection navigation anymore. On article reading only, an "已收藏" bookmark control means SAVE THIS ARTICLE, visually distinct from the bottom COLLECTION tab.

SCREEN 1 BOOKMARK COLLECTION:
Status bar 9:41. Slim masthead "富士見新聞文庫" at left, dark outline GEAR button at right (settings).
Large Mincho heading "收藏" with subtle count "18 篇", small subtitle "読み返したい記事を、ここに。". No new filters, tags, search, sorting toolbar, bulk edit or folders.
A beautiful saved article list of four compact editorial rows, separated with thin rules, not enclosed cards. Each row text left, small 90x76 thumbnail right. Useful Japanese headline 2 lines, source, saved-date metadata below. First row "秋深まる京都、街を彩る紅葉" with muted Kyoto-autumn-street photo, small "NHKニュース" and "11月2日 收藏". Second row "地域をつなぐ、新しい鉄道" with local train image and "朝日新聞" / "11月1日 收藏". Third "星空を見上げる、小さな旅" with night landscape and "読売新聞" / "10月31日 收藏". Fourth "本を開く、その時間がくれるもの" with quiet library photograph and "日本経済新聞" / "10月30日 收藏".
Each item has a subtle small filled bookmark icon near metadata to show saved state, not large destructive remove buttons. Blank breathing space under list is acceptable. Bottom navigation center 收藏 clearly selected.

SCREEN 2 ARTICLE WITH REDESIGNED COLLAPSED PLAYER:
Status bar 9:41. Header: back chevron and small "閲読室" left; compact bookmark icon plus visible "已收藏" text right, three-dot overflow at far right. This bookmark saves the CURRENT ARTICLE.
Source/date "NHKニュース　11月2日", large Mincho title "秋深まる京都、\n街を彩る紅葉".
Small unfilled reading toolbar "原文　译文　假名", black underline under 原文, dictionary icon at right.
Real Japanese prose in 17–18px Mincho, a few ruby only: "京都市内では、朝晩の冷え込みが続き、木々の葉が鮮やかに色づいています。"
Chinese translation on WHITE with a quiet left rule, label "译文" and "京都市内早晚持续降温，树叶逐渐染上鲜艳的秋色。".
Next Japanese paragraph "寺の境内には、秋の景色を楽しもうと多くの人が訪れています。". Subtle light-neutral-gray background only behind currently spoken sentence.
NEW MINI PLAYER is visually a low, compact white dock, 80–88px high, directly ABOVE bottom navigation with a fine top divider, not a big floating card. Its TOP EDGE is a slim progress line with 30% black fill. Inside one efficient horizontal row: left 36px muted article thumbnail; center compact two-line text, actual truncated article title "秋深まる京都、街を彩る紅葉" and smaller "即时朗读　0:42 / 2:18"; right black circular PAUSE button 38px; a small upward CHEVRON on far right to expand. Elegant vertical alignment and breathing room. NO other tiny cramped controls in the collapsed state. Reserve article scroll space above dock; dock never covers paragraph text or nav. This shows playback in progress; pause icon must match active state.

SCREEN 3 EXPANDED PLAYER:
Show the SAME article page behind a subtle dark translucent scrim. A new white audio-player BOTTOM SHEET covers about 70% of phone height; 24px top corners, slim centered drag handle, collapse downward chevron at top left and an accessible X stop/close button at top right. Sheet overlays the underlying bottom navigation; do NOT draw a second navigation inside the player.
At sheet top small label "即时朗读". Then a compact media-information row with 76x76 muted Kyoto thumbnail on left, 2-line title "秋深まる京都、街を彩る紅葉" on right and source "NHKニュース" below. No giant square album art, no turntable metaphor.
Next a clearly separated current-paragraph area on very light neutral gray, 16px internal padding, small label "第 3 / 12 段". Readable Japanese sentence "寺の境内には、秋の景色を楽しもうと多くの人が訪れています。". Below restrained Chinese translation "许多人来到寺院，欣赏秋日景色。". Sentence and title fully legible.
Next a FULL-WIDTH progress slider with dark filled first 30%, large usable thumb, tiny but readable time labels "0:42" left and "2:18" right.
Next a well-balanced THREE-control transport row centered: previous-paragraph icon + small text "上一段", a LARGE 60px solid charcoal circular PAUSE button in center, next-paragraph icon + small text "下一段". Do NOT depict rewind/forward 15 seconds: this app uses paragraph navigation.
Below a quiet single functional options row with three evenly spaced targets, each icon plus label: "1.0× 倍速", "对照阅读", "重听本段". These reflect existing app features. Icons black and consistent. No waveform, sleep timer, repeat playlist, queue, volume slider, downloads or new playback features. Proper bottom safe-area spacing.
Expanded and collapsed player use the SAME title, same photo, times and pause state. The player must be the focus of this screen, designed for comfortable real touch controls.

Quality: crisp accurate Japanese/simplified Chinese copy, legible smaller UI, no gibberish. All controls on screen and no accidental clipping. Complete production-quality conceptual UI, existing functionality only. Settings page itself belongs to the next board, only show its gear entry here.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a coherent high-fidelity SETTINGS design board for the existing Japanese personal news and literature reading app "富士見新聞文庫". Reference image 1 is the current visual STYLE AND NAVIGATION reference ONLY, not an edit target. Continue its sophisticated almost monochrome Japanese literary editorial style and the new navigation. This board shows THREE complete mobile UI screenshots: settings overview, daily-news configuration, voice-selection sheet. The user explicitly wants to see the redesigned settings.

COMPOSITION: high-resolution wide landscape, three equal complete 390:844 screen artboards, flat frontal presentation, subtle warm gray #E8E7E4 board, same white screens and 18px outer corners as reference. Screens large, aligned and well spaced. Small heading "富士見新聞文庫" and subtitle "设置界面设计". Under-screen captions "设置总览", "日刊設定", "声线选择". No hardware, perspective, props, external annotation arrows, color swatches, English marketing copy or 01/02 labels. Status bars 9:41.

VISUAL SYSTEM:
Pure white #FFFFFF, neutral #FAFAF8, charcoal #20201E, readable muted gray #777670, light rule #E4E3DF. Vermilion #A43A32 only a tiny existing active marker if needed; generally black-and-white controls. Absolutely no blue, purple, green panels or yellow/beige tint. No gradient, glassmorphism, huge rounded cards, dense boxed dashboards, enormous hero icon. Literary Mincho headlines 28px; Japanese/Chinese sans 15–16px setting labels, secondary 12–13px. Keep explanatory Chinese only where it is useful. Inner margins 24px, rows 52px tall, consistent fine-line icons. A small number of meaningful grouped row areas, mostly open white list rows with hairline separators. Group captions compact and quiet, enough separation between groups. Controls >=44px hit areas. Do not overwhelm the settings overview with editable fields.

NAVIGATION HAS CHANGED:
For full-page settings and daily-configuration screens keep the same FIVE bottom destinations "日刊", "閲読室", "收藏", "書架", "辞書" in EXACT order and same fine-line icons as reference. There is NO "設置" tab. All bottom items are neutral/inactive because settings was opened from the top-right gear. Settings is accessed by that gear on main list pages. Settings screen has a back arrow to exit. Do not add a sixth bottom tab. No centered floating button. On voice-selector screen a sheet overlays bottom nav and no duplicated nav inside sheet.

SCREEN 1 SETTINGS OVERVIEW:
Compact top bar: back chevron on left and small "富士見新聞文庫" wordmark, no redundant settings gear within settings. Then a left-aligned Mincho page title exactly "設置". A small subtitle "読む時間を、自分らしく。".
First OPEN white emphasis row, subtly separated with a thin rule, not colored: small speaker icon on left; label "声の形" and selected voice "系统日语声线" stacked; right chevron. This is the voice selector entry, high discoverability but no giant card.
Group caption "日刊". Two plain rows: "日刊設定" with summary "10 篇 / 6 来源" and chevron; "更新方式" with summary "每天 00:00 CST" and chevron.
Group caption "阅读与文庫". Rows "書架表示" summary "最近読んだ順" chevron; "文庫刷新" with chevron and a short secondary helper "检查本地内容并整理文庫".
Group caption "本机与同步". Rows "DeepSeek 翻译密钥" summary "未配置" chevron; "Windows 同步" summary "未连接" chevron.
A quiet final row "应用信息" with chevron. No login, profile avatar, theme, notification, subscription, payment, achievements, font size or line-height settings. No full API key, no file paths or implementation jargon.
Ensure entire overview fits above bottom nav without tiny cramped typography. The layout is clean and edited, with clear concise labels and aligned right values.

SCREEN 2 DAILY SETTINGS:
Top bar back chevron and compact "日刊設定". Header title "日刊設定" in 28px Mincho with short helper "安排每天的新闻阅读。". Only one prominent page heading (the small top title is functional, not a second giant heading).
A compact row "每日篇数", numeric stepper on right with minus, "10", plus. Label and control aligned.
Below small heading "新闻来源" and right summary "6 个来源". One helper line "设置各来源的每日最低收录数。".
Six clean compact rows with exact source names and a small right-aligned editable quota stepper minus / "1" / plus, accompanied by a tiny column label "最低篇数" above numeric column. Names:
"NHKニュース"
"朝日新聞"
"読売新聞"
"日本経済新聞"
"産経新聞"
"Yahoo!ニュース".
No logos, no fake badges, no article-count statistics.
A 22px section gap then label "生成方式". Small neutral two-choice control "自動更新" and "手動生成", auto selected with charcoal fill and white text; no blue selected state. Next time row "更新时刻（CST）" with time "00:00" and a clock icon. A subtle helper "按北京时间更新。".
A refined charcoal button "今すぐ生成" width matching page content and height 46px, clearly separate from automatic update setting. No fake success, progress or running-task claim. Fit button above bottom navigation. It is okay for some auxiliary copy to be omitted rather than shrink all text.
No quotas adding to more than 10. Do not add implementation text about SQLite, candidate validation or network retries.

SCREEN 3 VOICE PICKER:
Settings overview screen 1 behind a translucent dark scrim. White sheet rises from bottom and covers about 76% of the screen, 24px top corners, centered slim gray drag handle, title "声の形" and an X at upper right. Subtitle "用于文章、书籍与词典的即时朗读。".
Small section title "当前设备". First row selected: "系统日语声线", secondary "日本語 · 当前设备", filled charcoal radio on right. Selection indicated by a subtle neutral gray row background and charcoal radio, no red/blue box.
Small section title "本地模型". Rows of names with quiet subtitles and unselected/disabled outline radios:
"アルファ" with "Kokoro · 需要本地模型"
"春日部つむぎ" with "VOICEVOX · 需要本地模型"
"東北イタコ" with "VOICEVOX · 需要本地模型"
"東北ずん子" with "VOICEVOX · 需要本地模型"
and the next row "九州そら" partially visible to imply a scrollable list.
Do NOT claim local models are installed or work on Android. A fixed bottom footer has a single charcoal "试听当前声线" button with white speaker icon and a short readable helper "本地模型是否可用，以当前运行环境为准。". Footer separated by a light rule and does not obscure the last fully visible row; 5th row can be cropped only at scroll-area edge.
No Irodori synthesis capability claim, no model download/install buttons, no volume slider or waveform.

Keep components coherent with the reference. Prioritize careful typography, real mobile spacing, predictable hierarchy, complete visible controls and clean CJK glyphs. This is a design proposal with example values, not evidence of running software.
